subject: NorthStar: edge network acceptance + onboarding roadmap
messages:
From: Michael Bates <michael.bates@northstar.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood private deployment — initial network acceptance questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for moving this forward. Per our onboarding kickoff last week, the security team asked for a concise checklist we can run against our edge network and firewall team before the VPC peering and private deployment cutover.

Quick items they care about:
- Allowed outbound/inbound ports and CIDR ranges for control plane and data plane
- Expected TLS/SNI requirements and certificate pinning guidance
- Any egress inspection or proxy compatibility notes (we run Palo Alto + Zscaler)
- Requirements for KMS access (if using customer-managed keys) and the list of IPs that need to reach our HSM cluster

I can gather diagrams on our side; if you have a compact acceptance checklist we can use to validate the network readiness and schedule the handoff, please send it over.

Thanks,
Michael Bates
Head of Infrastructure
NorthStar Fintech

--
Attachment: northstar_network_diagram_v1.pdf (referenced)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Michael Bates <michael.bates@northstar.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial network acceptance questions

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list.

I'll attach our compact onboarding checklist (spreadsheet) and a short ‘edge acceptance’ reference we use for on-prem/VPC customers. High level answers inline:
- Ports/CIDRs: control plane (HTTPS to control.redwood.internal) 443 outbound; model serving 10250-10255 TCP for internal gRPC + 50051 for legacy routes — we’ll provide a final CIDR block mapped to the account.
- TLS: mutual TLS for control-plane webhook calls is optional but recommended; model traffic is TLS 1.2+ with SNI. We can support cert rotation via your KMS.
- Egress inspection: Our client can operate behind outbound proxy provided CONNECT/TLS pass-through is allowed for the specified destinations. Deep TLS inspection (MITM) will break model payload signatures.
- KMS: If using customer-managed keys, Redwoods' control plane needs HTTPS access to your KMS endpoint from these CIDRs. HSM traffic is outbound only on port 443.

I’m attaching the checklist now. Camila, can you add the exact CIDRs (per account) and the firewall rules export?

-Jonas

--
Attachment: redwood_private_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with column notes)

Folks,

Looping you in on NorthStar's network acceptance. They sent their diagram (attached to their message). Immediate asks before we finalize the private deployment schedule: 
1) Draft the account-scoped CIDR list (camila) — need to provide both control-plane and model-serving ranges.
2) Confirm whether we must require mTLS for the control-plane webhooks (security decision). Rishi, need your recommendation; if mandated we'll force it in the deployment template.
3) Validate our k8s node port ranges and outbound SNAT behavior with their NAT gateways. Ops should confirm no ephemeral ports are blocked.
4) Update the onboarding checklist row: expected cutover window and rollback steps (we should have a 2-hour rollback target for initial rollout).

I'll reply to Michael with a proposed window after we have the CIDRs and the mTLS call.

Thanks —
Jonas

Subject: Re: NorthStar: edge network acceptance + onboarding roadmap

Jonas / Camila — attaching the firewall export and an updated network diagram. Answers to your points: 
- We've exported our perimeter and VPC firewall rules (attached: northstar_vpc_firewall_rules.csv). Control-plane peering can be limited to 10.12.200.0/24. Model-serving nodes should be reachable from our NAT pools: 52.18.14.0/24 and 52.18.15.0/24.
- Security insists on TLS 1.3 where possible. They are open to mTLS for webhooks; their KMS team will let us register TLS client certs during the onboarding window.
- Our edge uses Palo Alto managed by a central team; they will not perform TLS MITM for the model traffic.

Attachments: northstar_network_diagram_v1.pdf, northstar_vpc_firewall_rules.csv

Proposed cutover windows (we prefer):
- Dec 8, 0200-0600 UTC (off-peak)
- Dec 10, 0200-0600 UTC (backup)

If you need access to our ticketing system or additional approvals, EdgeOps (cc'd) can coordinate the SOC change window.

Best,
Michael
